creators.name: Diana Nguyen & Cham "CK" Keat (@hypefoodies) — NoVA/DMV food couple who spotlight suburban mom-and-pops
creators.credible: Springfield, VA-based couple, full-time creators since 2017; beat is explicitly under-the-radar NoVA/DMV suburban mom-and-pops (they met at Eden Center's Rice Paper). Profiled by Washingtonian ('DC's Foodie TikTok Universe'), WJLA and NBC Washington; now throw the Hypefoodies Festival (WTOP-covered) drawing thousands. Findable NoVA content at a named place: Truong Tien / Eden Center, Falls Church (TikTok video 7281293878265646378).

creators.name: Keith Lee (@keith_lee125) — viral TikTok food critic; ran a documented DMV tour
creators.credible: ~17M TikTok followers; the 'Keith Lee Effect' is documented by WaPo, WJLA, Axios and NBC Washington. His Aug-2024 DMV tour hit named NoVA places on the record: Okonomi Asian Grill in Fairfax (his review, TikTok video 7405430595867692318; WaPo + WUSA9 coverage) and Flavor Hive in Annandale (WJLA 'everything Keith Lee ate' list). A corroborating creator source, not an institutional authority.

creators.name: Sandie S. (@adorkandherfork) — DMV food creative covering NoVA restaurants
creators.credible: ~52K Instagram; DMV food creator since 2018 with a running NoVA beat (findable reels at named NoVA places: Toimoi Bakery, Ballston Grill Kabob in Arlington, Incheon). Real track record and blog (adorkandherfork.com). Corroborating creator source.

creators.name: Shihan Chowdhury (@chilipeppercooks) — DMV Thai-chili recipe creator and Flavor Hive co-founder
creators.credible: TikTok ~1.8M / IG ~179K; MD-raised, DMV-based recipe creator profiled by The Business Standard and Famous Birthdays. Co-founder of Flavor Hive, the viral Annandale halal-bowls concept (NoVA Mag, WTOP). Note: recipe creator + owner — corroborates Flavor Hive as its founder, not as an independent reviewer.
